description: Lists Directus users (directus_users) with filtering, sorting, field selection, search and pagination. Use get_user to fetch one user when the id is known. Returns at most 25 users unless limit says otherwise. Results are scoped to the permissions of the token, so a token without access to directus_users gets an empty list rather than an error. Directus never returns password hashes or static tokens; pass fields to keep responses small.
name: get_users
